authority.precedence: This contract supersedes earlier substrate magnitudes, route stacking, Khajiit road-home circuits, and the Argonian composite metric. Historical proof remains evidence of the old implementation only.

devotionalDay.storedValue: devotionalDay + 2 (zero reserved; legacy +1 stamps migrate once)
devotionalDay.reason: GetDevotionalDay can be -1 before 06:00 on the first game day, so the encoded plus-one sentinel itself is shifted once more to keep zero unambiguously unset.

shared.recordDisplayPolicy: The SPEL FULL is the visible family/tier heading; each child MGEF FULL is the concise mechanical effect name or a distinct scripted-effect name. This keeps Active Effects legible without duplicate family lines.

visibleVocabulary.compatibilityException: Legacy EditorIDs, script names, properties, and StorageUtil keys may retain old internal names.

acceptedRenewableFamilies: first eligible Divine prayer of the devotional day
first completed Smithing craft of the devotional day
first completed Enchanting craft of the devotional day
first completed Alchemy craft of the devotional day
rejectedFamilies: civic action inventing Talos or other deity piety
substrates.overlapRule: A single act may separately award deity piety only when that act is authentically tied to the deity; substrate credit itself is piety-neutral.

curse.vampireOnset: Set metric to 0, strip substrate boons, and block civic and broad-pantheon gains.
curse.vampireCure: Seed metric to 20 once; two later devotional-day credits cross 25.

acceptedFiniteOrExactFamilies: approved DA01, DA02, or DA08 source membership

requires: victim level at least player level
honorableVictory.tracking: Clean combat state established before the killing blow.

substrates.overlapRule: An ash rite or victory awards deity piety separately only when the act is specifically authored for that Reclamation deity; no automatic Azura pulse.

acceptedRenewableFamilies: Hist Sap through an approved exact source
sustained exterior natural-water swimming or wading
first cooked meal of the devotional day
acceptedFiniteOrExactFamilies: approved Sithis source after Void activation
rejectedFamilies: relation values directly recomputing the cultural metric

relations.Hist: Independent relation and posture ledger with its own maintenance decay.
relations.People: Independent relation ledger and one possible active emphasis; it is not a deity.
relations.Void: Independent relation ledger and the alternative active emphasis; it can feed Sithis only after activation.
relations.activeEmphasis: Exactly one of People or Void.

pietyRouting.substrateCredit: Any accepted family may claim the day's piety-neutral cultural credit.

substrates.familyCap: Cultural substrate plus exactly one People-or-Void emphasis; no separate Hist Communion family.
substrates.migration: Preserve Hist, People, and Void ledgers; seed CulturalPractice once from the old clamped composite and cap at 75.
oldBehaviorSuperseded: Hist plus 0.25 People plus 0.10 Void composite

acceptedRenewableFamilies: first cooked meal of the devotional day
rejectedFamilies: separate standing, rest, and hearth positive metric writes
indoor generic rest as Sky Road practice
substrates.overlapRule: Substrate credit is deity-neutral. A qualifying act may separately award piety only to a god authentically tied to the act and eligible in the active pantheon baseline.
sourceCorrections: Resolve C06 Hircine and Arkay tokens by exact source

acceptedRenewableFamilies: ordered rest after the rite decision
first daily increase among the six magic skills
first successful enchantment of the devotional day
rejectedFamilies: independent same-day +5 awards from sleep, dawn, rite, book, and skill
substrates.riteRule: Not Yet grants no metric and does not spend the seven-day accepted-rite cooldown; it starts only a separate three-devotional-day reprompt cooldown. Accepting a rite choice starts the seven-day rite cooldown.
substrates.overlapRule: Auri-El, Magnus, or Xarxes piety is separately act-specific; the substrate helper never creates a universal Auri-El pulse.

acceptedRenewableFamilies: completed outdoor rest as road-home practice
approved Alkosh dragon or Word milestone
substrates.roadHomeRule: The outdoor road itself is home. No designated anchor, circuit, or repeated-location rejection is part of normal play.
substrates.roadHomeClassification: Capture exterior or interior status at sleep start and treat it as authoritative at completed, non-interrupted sleep stop. Do not resample the wake cell. Missing sleep-start context fails closed.

roadHomePresentation.cadence: First completed outdoor rest per 06:00 devotional day.
roadHomePresentation.dailyCreditAlreadySpent: The road home was remembered. Today's lunar practice was already marked.
roadHomePresentation.laterSameDay: No additional road-home toast or Book of Days entry.

observeTheMoons.resolution: One check after two seconds; abort on combat, cell change, or movement over 128 units; no continuous polling.
observeTheMoons.presentation: Observe the Moons and Survey Devotion are peer lesser powers in the shared Power slot; selecting either replaces the other, but origin setup never changes the player's selection. Both are granted through AddSpell only: vanilla EquipSpell is hand-only and must never be used to select either power. The non-blocking Prisma toast presents the authored contemplation; the first valid rite each devotional day also enters the Book of Days.

messages.compiledFallback: The existing four lines per god remain the missing-or-invalid-JSON fallback.

observeTheMoons.laterSuccessSameDay: Informational-only non-blocking Prisma contemplation; it creates no Book of Days entry.
